cells.name: L. lactis
cells.note: Aerotolerant anaerobe. Converts glucose almost quantitatively into L-lactate.

cells.name: E. coli
cells.note: Facultative heterotroph. Ferments to acetate, formate and ethanol when O2 runs short.

cells.name: S. cerevisiae
cells.note: Eukaryote. Crabtree positive: ferments to ethanol even with O2 when glucose is in excess.

cells.name: Methanosarcina
cells.note: Strictly anaerobic archaeon. Consumes the acetate and H2/CO2 the bacteria ferment, and releases methane.
